• Apoiar - Programa de Assistência ao Empregado e Dependentes: suporte emocional e social especializados para empregados e suas famílias;
• Cartão Presente de Natal para Dependentes: um gesto de carinho no final do ano - para dependentes até 10 anos;
• Transporte fretado ou Vale transporte: garantias de deslocamento diário de nossos empregados para o ambiente de trabalho;
• Passagens de trem de passageiros na Estrada de Ferro Vitória a Minas (EFVM) e/ou na Estrada de Ferro Carajás (EFC). Destinadas para uso pessoal, viabilizando mais uma opção logística para viagens dos empregados;
• Incentivo à atividade física - Wellhub: promoção de saúde física e bem-estar com programas de atividade física;
• Programa Bem-Estar: cuidados integrais para melhorar a qualidade de vida dos empregados;
• Clube de Vantagens: Descontos e benefícios exclusivos para compras em estabelecimentos parceiros.
Entre outros ...
Como é trabalhar na Vale?
Na Vale, contribuímos para a formação de futuros. Da mineração, do planeta e o seu. Oferecemos oportunidades para diversas áreas e objetivos profissionais. Aqui, nossos talentos constroem juntos um ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo que valoriza a pessoa como ela é: sua individualidade, seu protagonismo e comprometimento.
Na Vale, aprendemos juntos. Acreditamos na riqueza das experiências do dia a dia e na troca de conhecimento entre os talentos. Aqui, todo momento pode e deve ser um aprendizado.
Na Vale, também crescemos juntos. Estabelecemos relações sólidas e de valor compartilhado com os nossos empregados e a sociedade. Assim, demonstramos nosso comprometimento com um legado positivo, resultados consistentes e com a construção de uma mineração com processos mais inovadores e sustentáveis: a mineração do futuro.
Onde tem futuro, a Vale está.

Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack / .NET)

Join to apply for the Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack / .NET) role at OPW .

About the Company

Innovative Controls Systems (ICS), part of OPW VWS (A Dover Company), is a leader in Vehicle Wash Manufacturing, specializing in POS Management Systems, Payment Terminals, Car Wash Controllers, and Accessories. OPW has a global presence with manufacturing in North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific, and is part of Dover Corporation (NYSE: DOV). For more information, visit .

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and debug source code, including ASP.net web applications (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, C#).
  • Create data-driven Web Services for IIS and MS-SQL.
  • Consume and create RESTful API calls.
  • Develop user-friendly front-end applications using Angular.
  • Develop SSRS reports per client requirements.
  • Gather requirements from clients and document them.
  • Design, develop, and optimize custom applications; perform performance tuning.
  • Conduct unit testing and debugging throughout the development cycle.
  • Collaborate with peers across all development stages.
  • Optimize SQL queries and stored procedures; document code functionalities.
  • Participate in requirements analysis and design reviews.
  • Conduct peer code reviews and recommend improvements.
  • Contribute positively to team efforts and mentor junior engineers.
  • Produce comprehensive software documentation, including design and test plans.
  • Assist in testing and support of field issues.

Personal Skills

  • Take ownership of projects and results.
  • Be result-oriented and willing to tackle challenging assignments.
  • Possess good planning and communication skills.

  • Stay focused and meet deadlines.
  • Maintain a positive, proactive attitude.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • At least 3 years of web application development experience with HTML, CSS, Java, JavaScript, and C#.
  • Experience with multi-threaded applications, RESTful APIs, JSON, jQuery, Angular.
  • Knowledge of IIS, web services, and experience in POS or shopping cart applications is a plus.
  • Proficiency in SSRS, MS-SQL, Entity Framework, LINQ, and troubleshooting SQL databases.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC and proven track record of high-quality software production.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

The role is onsite, with moderate noise levels; travel may be required. Physical demands include standing, walking, sitting, lifting up to 50 pounds, and good vision.

title: Data Protection Analyst (1785)
description:
Join Our Team at Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC

At Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC, we are proud to be a global leader and innovator in the direct selling industry, with more than 50 years of sustained growth and meaningful impact across 7 countries.

Our people are the heart of our success. We embrace the unique experiences, cultural backgrounds, and perspectives that each team member brings—because we know that diversity drives innovation and connection. By fostering an inclusive environment built on trust, support, and authenticity, we’re able to better understand and serve our distributors and customers around the world.

We are looking for our next: Data Protection Analyst in Barueri, São Paulo, Brazil

What The Role Involves

The Data Protection Analyst will be a valued collaborator across Legal, IT, and Information Security functions, supporting global data privacy and cybersecurity standards including LGPD, CPRA, GLBA, and NYDFS Reg 500. This person will engage with teams across regions and disciplines to help embed legal requirements into everyday practices through project support, training, and thoughtful documentation.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Support business and IT projects by reviewing proposed data use, identifying privacy and cybersecurity requirements, assisting with Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and helping resolve identified risks.
  • Partner with Legal, IT, and Compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are considered early in project planning—helping prevent costly rework, missed deadlines, and scope changes.
  • Support vendor oversight by maintaining an inventory of required privacy and security terms in standard contracts, tracking approved deviations, and identifying which vendors process personal data (PII). Coordinate with Legal to flag gaps and support ongoing vendor risk management.
  • Triage and respond to incoming questions about data privacy and security; maintain clear documentation of actions and decisions.
  • Monitor and assess digital tracking practices (e.g., website cookies) for compliance with global requirements.
  • Support privacy governance tools (e.g., BigID, OneTrust) by helping ensure legal requirements are reflected in data inventories, records of processing, and risk documentation.
  • Support responses to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and related compliance reporting.
  • Help develop and deliver internal training to promote awareness and understanding of data privacy and legal requirements related to cybersecurity.
  • Follow all legal and compliance policies and report any potential issues or breaches.

What We’re Looking For

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year institution.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience, ideally in privacy, data governance, or security roles.
  • Working knowledge of regulations such as LGPD, CPRA, and NYDFS Reg 500.
  • Familiarity with tools like OneTrust or BigID is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between legal, business, and technical teams.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage deadlines and work with cross-functional teams.
  • CIPP certification is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is strongly preferred.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about protecting data, collaborating across global teams, and growing your career in a purpose-driven environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of our inclusive team.

Hy Cite is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, recognizing that it builds stronger teams. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take our responsibility seriously to consider qualified applicants on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, marital status, citizenship, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by applicable law.

Job Title: Supply Chain Manager
Job Description
The Supply Chain Manager will be responsible for Planning, Scheduling, Procurement, and Inventory Management to support production and distribution needs. This role requires a strategic thinker who can drive operational efficiency, optimize inventory, and ensure seamless coordination between suppliers, manufacturing, and distribution.
Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes to align demand and supply.
  • Create production schedules that balance efficiency, capacity, and demand fluctuations.
  • Work closely with manufacturing, sales, and logistics teams to optimize scheduling and minimize downtime.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as on-time delivery, schedule adherence, and capacity utilization.
  • Develop and execute procurement strategies to optimize cost, quality, and lead times.
  • Negotiate contracts and maintain strong relationships with vendors and suppliers.
  • Ensure raw materials and packaging availability while mitigating supply chain risks.
  • Monitor supplier performance, addressing issues related to delivery, cost, or quality.
  • Implement inventory control processes to optimize stock levels and minimize waste.
  • Ensure raw materials and finished goods inventory align with demand forecasts and production plans.
  • Work with warehouse and logistics teams to improve inventory accuracy and reduce excess/obsolete stock.
  • Leverage data analytics to enhance decision-making and inventory forecasting.
  • Issue purchase orders and address receipt variances with vendors.
  • Maintain the vendor master data in the ERP.
Essential Skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Operations, Business, or related field.
  • 5-10 years of experience in supply chain roles within food manufacturing or CPG industries.
  • Strong understanding of production planning, procurement, and inventory management best practices.
  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent negotiation, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Additional Skills & Qualifications
  • Knowledge of food safety regulations, USDA/FDA compliance, and supply chain sustainability is a plus.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior DevOps Engineer role at Rain .

About Rain

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees. Backed by top investors like QED and Prosus, we have raised nearly $400M, including the largest Series A in fintech history, and recently closed our Series B to fuel hypergrowth. We seek a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our innovative team.

Role Overview

This role involves designing, deploying, and managing scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications. You will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment for our microservices architecture. If you thrive in automation, scalability, and observability environments, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Infrastructure Automation: Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt. Automate provisioning and deployment of AWS resources for high availability and scalability.
  2. Microservices Deployment: Build and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes with Helm. Support and enhance microservices developed in Go (Golang).
  3. CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and maintain pipelines in GitLab CI/CD for build, test, and deployment workflows, optimizing for performance, reliability, and security.
  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and performance, proactively resolving issues.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Work with development and QA teams, document processes, workflows, and playbooks for knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience

  1. Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments.
  2. Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  3. Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  4. Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  5. Experience with monitoring tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  6. Familiarity with Helm and secure deployment practices.
  7. Public cloud certifications in AWS and/or Kubernetes are a plus.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with SRE practices and incident management.
  • Proficiency in developing/deploying microservices, especially with Go.
  • Knowledge of multi-environment infrastructure setups.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL and load balancing in cloud environments.

Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.

The security engineering team’s primary responsibility is to respond to emerging threats and secure the open source ecosystem for both community and enterprise users. Your work will involve addressing CVEs and vulnerabilities in Canonical products such as Ubuntu. You will engage with the community and customers and coordinate with multiple engineering teams.

An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. Developing engineering talent, representing your team and product technically, and fostering collaboration are key to success in this role.

  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunities for travel and meeting colleagues
  • Travel perks for company events

Canonical pioneers in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We are a remote-first company since 2004, committed to excellence and innovation. We value diversity and are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior ML Backend Engineer
description:
Intuition Machines builds enterprise security products with an AI/ML focus. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.


What you will do:

  • Design, build, and maintain highly reliable backend systems that scale to millions of requests per second (RPS).
  • Translate business goals into technical specifications and iterative development plans. We ship early and often, and our first customer of a new product or feature may involve deploying it to 500 million users.
  • Work with queue-driven and event-driven designs, REST APIs, serverless and microservice architectures, and multi-cloud/multi-CDN environments using Kubernetes and other orchestrators.
  • Write Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (JS/TS) as necessary to meet business objectives.
  • Focus on producing clearly structured, maintainable, well-documented, and tested code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
  • Collaborate with other backend developers to integrate your work with our infrastructure, including automating observability, deployment, quality, and security.
  • Participate in code reviews and architecture & design sessions. Stay up-to-date with recent developments in relevant technologies and assess their applicability.
  • Take ownership of tasks that are not fully defined, proactively helping the team to shape and implement them.


What we are looking for:

  • Thoughtful, conscientious, and self-directed individuals.
  • 5+ years of professional experience building and maintaining large-scale production systems, with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • In-depth knowledge of Python.
  • Experience with orchestration platforms (e.g., Argo, Kubernetes), containerization, and microservice design.
  • Experience with database systems (SQL, NoSQL), distributed systems and architectures, stream processing, test-driven development (TDD), and CI/CD.
  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in a technical or related field from an accredited college or university, or equivalent job experience.
  • Excellent communication, listening, and presentation skills, with experience interacting with diverse audiences and mentoring peers.
  • Experience leading technical discussions with a team and driving decisions by balancing trade-offs.


Nice to Have:

  • College-level knowledge of mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, probability theory, statistics, matrix calculus).
  • Experience with Rust, Go, or other programming languages.
  • Ability to understand and write code in JavaScript/TypeScript (JS/TS).
  • Practical experience applying machine learning (ML) concepts, such as optimization, classification, regression, and generalization.


What we offer:

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.
  • Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.
  • High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.
  • Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all members of our team.

Join us as we transform cyber security, user privacy, and machine learning online!

Sobre o Stark Bank

Você se imagina trabalhando em uma empresa que antecipa o futuro simplificando o presente? Esse é o Stark Bank, banco das empresas que vem crescendo exponencialmente no Brasil.

Nascemos em 2018 e oferecemos a melhor tecnologia para gestão financeira de pagamentos e recebimentos. Temos orgulho de dizer que nossos desenvolvedores criaram uma das APIs mais completas e amigáveis do mercado para oferecer produtos financeiros de forma inovadora.

Apesar de sermos jovens, somos lucrativos desde 2020 e estamos na Serie B, com grandes investidores por trás. Somos a primeira startup brasileira a receber investimentos de um fundo privado do Jeff Bezos, o fundador da Amazon!

Buscamos pessoas que entendam como encantar clientes internos, queiram quebrar recordes e fazer história, construindo o melhor banco do universo!

Sobre a posição:

No time de riscos, você será responsável pela elaboração de indicadores, monitoramento e análise de riscos financeiros e de gestão de capital do Stark Bank, garantindo a conformidade com as regulamentações vigentes.

Você estará à frente da implementação de modelos de avaliação de risco, projeções de capital e análise de impactos financeiros em cenários macroeconômicos e regulatórios!

Você irá:
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de riscos de mercado, crédito e liquidez, com foco em capital e adequação regulatória (Basileia III, por exemplo);
  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas e modelos de análise de risco, incluindo ferramentas quantitativas e de visualização de dados, para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas;
  • Gerenciar o cálculo e a projeção de requisitos de capital do banco, com base nas metodologias estabelecidas e mudanças regulatórias;
  • Monitorar e avaliar o impacto de eventos macroeconômicos e alterações regulatórias nos requisitos de capital do banco;
  • Desenvolver modelos e cenários de stress test para simulação de variáveis de risco em diferentes cenários financeiros;
  • Preparar relatórios periódicos para a alta direção e órgãos reguladores, apresentando análises, conclusões e recomendações sobre o risco de capital;
  • Acompanhar e aplicar mudanças na regulamentação de capital e adequação financeira, incluindo as mudanças previstas nas políticas do Bacen e demais órgãos reguladores;
  • Apoiar as áreas internas na definição de estratégias de mitigação de riscos financeiros, colaborando com outras áreas, como Produtos, Tesouraria, Crédito e Compliance.
O que não pode faltar:
  • Formação superior em Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Gestão de Riscos ou áreas afins será um diferencial;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em funções similares, com forte atuação em gestão de risco financeiro, análise de capital e regulação bancária;
  • Profundo conhecimento das normas de adequação de capital (Basileia III), métricas de risco e gestão de capital regulatório;
  • Habilidades analíticas e quantitativas para avaliar cenários de risco e realizar projeções de capital sob diferentes condições econômicas;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e assertiva, tanto para apresentações para a alta direção quanto para relatórios técnicos;
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas e de modelagem financeira;
  • Inglês avançado.

title: Página da Vaga | Analista Senior de Security Operations (SecOps & IAM)
description:
Job description

Modelo de trabalho:

Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto

Sobre o time:

O time de cyber security é responsável por mapear riscos, prevenir ameaças de segurança da informação, detectar e responder a incidentes aqui da Conta Simples.

Desafios da posição:

Você será o protagonista na defesa cibernética da nossa fintech, gerenciando as operações de segurança e a gestão de identidades e acessos, assegurando que nossas plataformas e dados estejam sempre protegidos e em conformidade. Em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante crescimento, seu trabalho será fundamental para antecipar, mitigar e responder a incidentes de segurança, além de garantir que o controle de acesso aos sistemas seja robusto e eficiente. O desafio será identificar vulnerabilidades, implementar melhorias contínuas e garantir uma integração fluida entre segurança e usabilidade para todos os nossos colaboradores e clientes.

Main responsibilities

Seu dia a dia na Conta Simples:

  • Gestão de Incidentes de Segurança: Conduzir a resposta a incidentes de segurança com base nas melhores práticas do NIST Incidente Handling (Preparação, Detecção e Análise, Contenção, Erradicação, Recuperação e Post-Mortem) contribuindo na investigação e interpretação de logs, identificação de atividades suspeitas, atuar em um war room quando necessário e escrever post-mortem de resolução do incidente como parte da governança da resposta a incidente cibernético além de conduzir treinamentos e exercícios de resposta a incidentes a fim de melhorar a capacidade do time Conta Simples na resposta eficaz de incidentes de segurança.
  • Investigação de Fraudes Cibernéticas: coletar requisitos necessários para direcionar a investigação e interpretação de logs a fim de identificar de atividades suspeitas, atuar em um war room quando necessário e escrever relatório com parecer técnico sobre investigação de Fruades Cibernéticas ao documentar indicios de fraudes cibernéticas, identificação de potenciais as causas raiz e propondo ações melhorias e/ou corretivas.
  • Segurança Corporativa: Manter e melhorar a segurança de dispositivos corporativos e pessoais (notebooks com Windows, Linux, Mac), utilizando ferramentas de Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), web filters, VPNs e serviços de diretórios, além de gerenciar configurações de hardening e manter nível de vulnerabilidade aderente qualidade alinhada as políticas de segurança.
  • Gestão de Identidades e Acessos (IAM): Responsável pela gestão de acessos (criação, alteração, remoção e revisão de privilégios), integrações via Single Sign-On (SSO) e SAML, além de garantir o controle de matrizes de acesso (RBAC, SOD) e auditorias regulares.
  • Monitoramento Proativo e Melhorias: Implementar soluções e estratégias para a prevenção de riscos, monitorando a infraestrutura de segurança para identificar e corrigir vulnerabilidades antes que se tornem incidentes críticos.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada em Security Operations e IAM: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em operações de segurança, gestão de identidade e acesso em ambientes corporativos complexos, especialmente em fintechs ou empresas de grande porte.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas: Capacidade de identificar, investigar e resolver incidentes de segurança com agilidade, mantendo o foco na minimização de impactos operacionais.
  • Capacidade de documentação e comunicação: Habilidade para elaborar relatórios técnicos claros e concisos sobre incidentes de segurança e propostas de mitigação, com comunicação eficaz para times técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Conhecimento profundo em protocolos de segurança e ferramentas: Familiaridade com protocolos como SSO, SAML, OAuth, e Active Directory, bem como experiência prática com ferramentas de EDR, VPN, firewalls, web filters e serviços de diretórios.
  • Sólida compreensão de frameworks e boas práticas de segurança: Profundo entendimento dos princípios do NIST, do modelo de segurança Zero Trust, e das melhores práticas de hardening de sistemas.
  • Proatividade e foco na melhoria contínua: Buscar sempre aprimorar os processos, implementar novos controles e garantir a proteção de ativos críticos da empresa.

Será diferencial se você tiver:

  • Certificações relevantes, como CISSP, CISM, CISA, CompTIA Security+, ou outras na área de segurança.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação de segurança (SIEMs, SOARs) e integração com ferramentas de cloud.
  • Contribuições para comunidades de segurança, como participação em fóruns ou blogs especializados.
